show.reply: No values. Actions are optional; closing the surface replies `dismiss`.

ask.reply: The values of its inputs, by name.

choose.reply: The picked value under the choice's name; a list when `multiple`.

confirm.reply: `{}`. The application may ask the person to type a confirmation.

review.reply: The ids of the accepted diff rows or selected table rows, under the input's name.

questionnaire.reply: `{answers, path}`: the answers by step name and the steps taken.

line.title: Surface operation
line.description: One line of a surface stream.

document.title: Surface document
document.description: A whole surface in one object.

tools.name: show_surface
tools.description: Show the person a surface composed from the catalog: a rich answer, a form, a choice, a confirmation, a review or a questionnaire. Returns the person's reply: the action taken and the values entered.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the person for values you need, with a form of one or more fields nodes. Returns their reply: `submit` with the values, or `cancel`.
